<r=アマツミカボシ>天津甕星</r>・<r=ギョウセイ>暁星</r>と対峙して:
Facing <r=アマツミカボシ>Amatsu-Mikaboshi</r> - <r=ギョウセイ>Daybreak Star</r>
are the two teams, Colorful Bouquet and InScarlet.
気をつけて！\nまたレーザーが来るわよ！:
Watch out!
Here comes another laser!
全員、回避！ ……くっ、もう！\nドローンの対処もしないといけないのに！:
Everyone, evade! ...Ugh, come on!
We've got drones to deal with too!
泉花、不満を言っても仕方ない。\n隙を見て、奴を撃墜するしかないだろう。:
Senka, complaining won't help.
We'll have to find an opening and shoot it down.
各校舎実力最上位クラスの６人がかりでも、\n暁星を相手に苦戦を強いられていた。:
Even with six of the top pilots from their respective school buildings working together,
Daybreak Star is proving a formidable opponent.
しかしそれでも開幕一発目に、遠距離射撃が一度命中したことで\nやや相手の攻撃時の:
Fortunately, a long-range shot landed at the very start of the battle,
reducing the accuracy of its attacks somewhat.
その功労者は、『エクスプローラー・バラージ』を駆るヒイロである。: They have Hiiro, piloting the Explorer Barrage, to thank for that.
もし相手が無傷で十全な状態なら、今頃精密な砲撃の雨とレーザーから\n逃れるために:
Had the enemy remained undamaged and fully operational, they would have been forced
into cover by now to escape its lasers and rain of precision fire.
その後も新機体の性能を活かし、ヒイロは何度も攻撃を当てている。\nだが、暁星は倒:
Hiiro continues to make the most of her new unit, landing hit after hit.
But Daybreak Star will not fall.
１発目は上手くセンサー部分にダメージを与えることに成功したが、\n２発目以降はさ:
The first shot successfully damaged its sensors,
but from the second shot on, it hasn't let her hit that spot again.
銃撃自体は当たるのだ。しかしそれは暁星が攻撃を避けるのは困難と\n判断したのか、:
Her shots do connect. Perhaps deciding that evasion is too difficult,
Daybreak Star has switched to defending itself instead.
むしろ装甲の硬い部位で受け止めるよう立ち回るので、\n決定打にならない。:
It maneuvers to take the hits on its heavily armored sections,
preventing any decisive damage.
あ、当たりました！\nこ、このままなら、まだ攻められます……！:
Y-You hit it!
W-We can keep attacking like this...!
いや、弾かれた……！ 榊野！\n右へ回避しろ！:
No, it bounced off...! Sakakino!
Dodge right!
硬い装甲に阻まれ、反撃を受けそうになるたび、\nヒイロは葵達の援護でどうにかしの:
Whenever the armor stops her shots and a counterattack looms,
Hiiro barely manages to hold out with support from Aoi and the others.
……助かった。でも、かなり厄介。\nこのままじゃ、削りきれない。:
...Thanks. But this is a real problem.
I can't wear it down like this.
そうね……レーザーも厄介だけど、思った以上に硬いわ。\n急所をきちんと狙わないと:
Yes... The laser's bad enough, but it's tougher than I expected, too.
Unless we hit a weak point squarely, we won't do much damage.
もう対処されてる。弱点を隠して、\n他の部分でカバーしてる。:
It's already adapted. It's hiding its weak points
and shielding them with other parts.
現状では突破に必要な火力が足りない。\n戦況は膠着し、じりじりと消耗させられてい:
They lack the firepower needed to break through.
The battle is at a stalemate, slowly wearing them down.
……ほんと厄介ね。\nただでさえドローンの物量だけで手が足りないっていうのに……:
...What a pain.
Our hands are full just dealing with all those drones...
かといって、破れかぶれに突撃して、\nレーザーの直撃を受ければ、一撃で戦闘不能だ:
But if we charge in recklessly,
a direct hit from the laser will take us out in one shot.
しかも向こうは、被弾を恐れずに立ち回ってくる。\n削り合いになったら、こっちのほ:
And it's not afraid to take a hit.
If this turns into a battle of attrition, we're at a disadvantage...
近づいて攻撃した時、レーザーに少し隙ができるのは見えたけど、\nドローンと砲撃で:
I saw a brief opening in its laser fire when we attacked up close,
but the drones and cannon fire cover it... There's no chance to strike.
じゃ、じゃあ、どうしようもないんですかぁ……！？\nうぅ……このままわたし達、や:
Th-Then there's nothing we can do...?!
Ugh... Are we just going to lose...?
そんなに悲観的にならないの！\nとはいえ、どこかでリスクを取らないと突破は難しそ:
Don't be so pessimistic!
Still, it'll be hard to break through unless we take a risk somewhere...
ヒイロは何かを思いついたように、\nカラフルブーケのメンバーへ声をかける。:
Apparently struck by an idea,
Hiiro calls out to the members of Colorful Bouquet.
……どうした、榊野？\n何かあるのか？:
...What is it, Sakakino?
Do you have something in mind?
提案がある。ここで勝つための作戦。\n……聞いてくれる？:
I have a plan. A way to win this.
...Will you hear me out?
へえ、あの一匹狼の榊野ヒイロから、作戦を提案されるなんて……: Well, well. A plan from the lone wolf herself, Sakakino Hiiro...
かなり危険な役目を、お願いしたい。: I need to ask you to do something quite dangerous.
リスクはある。でも、一番確実に倒せる。: There's a risk. But it's our best chance of taking it down.
うん。\nまず、みんなには──:
Okay.
First, I need you all to—
……そして、ヒイロの作戦を聞いたカラフルブーケの面々は、\n思わず驚きの声を漏ら:
After hearing Hiiro's plan, the members of Colorful Bouquet
cannot help voicing their surprise.
……私達も危険だけど、\nそれ以上に、あなた自身が一番危険じゃない？:
...It'll be dangerous for us,
but won't you be in more danger than anyone?
少しでもタイミングを外したら、\n私達は回避できても……あなたが危ないわ。:
If our timing is even slightly off,
we might be able to dodge... but you'd be in danger.
な、なんで大丈夫って言えるんですかぁ……！？\nだ、だって、一番危ないのはヒイロ:
H-How can you say that...?!
Y-You're the one taking the biggest risk, Hiiro-san...!
ここまで一緒に戦ったから、わかる。\nカラフルブーケなら、信頼できる。:
I know from fighting alongside you this far.
I can trust Colorful Bouquet.
%usernameusernameuserna%に言われたことがある。\n『誰か:
%usernameusernameuserna% once told me,
"It's important to rely on others, too."
だから考えた。あなた達なら頼れるって。\n……ダメ？:
So I thought about it. I can rely on you.
...Can't I?
その言葉を聞き、葵達は顔を見合わせる。\nそして、思わず笑みをこぼした。:
Aoi and the others exchange glances at her words.
Then, despite themselves, they smile.
あはは……本当のとこ実はちょっと怖い人だと思ってた。\nでも意外とかわいいところ:
Ahaha... Honestly, I thought you were a little scary.
But you've got a cute side after all.
インスカーレットの榊野ヒイロさんから、\n『頼れる』って言われたら……断れないわ:
When InScarlet's Sakakino Hiiro-san
says she can rely on us... how could we refuse?
し、失望されないように頑張ります……！: I-I'll do my best not to let you down...!
私達の気持ちは決まってるわ。\nそれで、葵。どうする？:
We've made up our minds.
So, Aoi. What's your decision?
……榊野ヒイロ。カラフルブーケは君の作戦に乗ろう。\n信じてくれたのだから、その:
...Sakakino Hiiro. Colorful Bouquet will follow your plan.
You've put your trust in us. We won't let you down.
──そして、<r=アマツミカボシ>天津甕星</r>・<r=ギョウセイ>暁星</r:
And so, the operation against <r=アマツミカボシ>Amatsu-Mikaboshi</r> - <r=ギョウセイ>Daybreak Star</r> begins,
following Hiiro's plan.
号令に従い、カラフルブーケは一斉に加速する。\n暁星へ、まっすぐ突撃を仕掛けた。:
At the command, Colorful Bouquet accelerates as one,
charging straight at Daybreak Star.
ぼ、妨害なんてさせません！\nわ、わたしだってやります！:
I-I won't let you stop us!
I-I can fight too!
行く手を塞ぐドローンが殺到する。\nクララが次々と撃墜し、うるうも絨毯爆撃でドロ:
Drones swarm in to block their path.
Kurara shoots them down one after another, while Uruu destroys more with carpet bombing.
クララさん！\n次は右手の一団を！:
Kurara-san!
Take the group on the right next!
了解！\nまとめてぶっ倒すわ！:
Roger!
I'll take them all out!
泉花は戦況を見極め、次々と的確な指示を飛ばす。\nその指示を受け、仲間達の動きが:
Reading the battlefield, Senka issues a steady stream of precise instructions.
Under her guidance, her teammates' movements fall into sync.
葵が行く手を塞ぐドローンを撃墜し、道を開ける。\nその瞬間、超高出力レーザーが放:
Aoi shoots down the drones blocking their way and opens a path.
At that instant, an ultra-high-output laser fires—
──その攻撃は、もう見切っている！: I've already seen through that attack!
紙一重でレーザーをかわした葵は長刀を構え、\n暁星へ一撃を叩き込む。:
Aoi dodges the laser by a hair, readies her long blade,
and strikes Daybreak Star.
恐らくはＭＡＸまでのチャージを諦めたのだろう。\n最低限の破壊力を担保し次第、照:
It has probably given up on charging to full power.
It seems to be firing as soon as it has enough energy to do the necessary damage.
葵と入れ替わるように、反対側から舞亜が突撃する。\nそれを見た暁星は、舞亜へ矛先:
Maia charges from the opposite side, moving to take Aoi's place.
Seeing her, Daybreak Star changes targets.
しかし舞亜は、直撃寸前……ほんの数センチの差で、\n超高出力レーザーをかわしてみ:
But just before the ultra-high-output laser hits,
Maia dodges it with mere centimeters to spare.
嘘……あの距離で、かわした……！？: No way... She dodged it at that range...?!
直後、舞亜は葵と同じ場所へ痛烈な長刀の一撃を叩き込み、\nついに装甲に亀裂を入れ:
Immediately afterward, Maia delivers a vicious slash to the same spot Aoi struck,
finally cracking the armor.
だが、それでも撃墜には至らない。\n暁星は舞亜を脅威とみなし、動きを止めた彼女へ:
But it is still not enough to bring Daybreak Star down.
Deeming Maia a threat, it aims at her now-motionless unit.
……くすっ、こっちを見たわね？ おバカさん。: ...Hehe. Looking at me, are you? You silly thing.
──この瞬間を、ずっと待っていた。: I've been waiting for this moment.
カラフルブーケの戦いがどれほど激しくなっても、\nヒイロは決して敵に気配を悟らせ:
No matter how fierce Colorful Bouquet's battle becomes,
Hiiro stays hidden from the enemy, waiting patiently for her chance.
死角から急接近したヒイロの機体は、暁星の亀裂に――\n否、その奥の機体中枢へ照準:
Rushing in from a blind spot, Hiiro aims at the crack in Daybreak Star's armor—
no, at the unit's core beyond it.
方法は簡単。戦っている間に、あいつのコアを貫く隙を見つける。\n狙える瞬間さえ見:
It's simple. While you're fighting, I'll find an opening to pierce its core.
Give me a moment to aim, and I won't miss.
野生の獣は、獲物を狩る瞬間が一番無防備になる。そこを狙いたい。\n──だから、あ:
A wild beast is most vulnerable when it strikes its prey. That's the moment I want.
So I need you to act as decoys.
（……私の無茶なお願いに応えてくれた。\nなら、今度は私が応える番……！）:
(...They did what I asked, no matter how reckless it was.
Now it's my turn to come through for them...!)
暁星はレーザーを撃とうにも、\nまだ必要最低限の充填すらできていない。:
Daybreak Star tries to fire its laser,
but it has not even reached the minimum charge.
ならばと火砲の照準をエクスプローラー・バラージに向けるも――: It aims its cannons at the Explorer Barrage instead, but—
それはもう遅く、\nヒイロによる全力のゼロ距離一斉射撃を叩き込まれた。:
It is already too late.
Hiiro hits it with an all-out salvo at point-blank range.
亀裂の入った装甲にゼロ距離で撃ち込まれては、\nさすがの暁星でも耐えられず――:
Even Daybreak Star cannot withstand
point-blank fire into its cracked armor—
照準だけ定めた砲口は火を吹くことなく、\nまるで全身が脱力したように機能を停止す:
Its guns fall silent before they can fire,
as though all strength has left its body.
そして、そのまま地面へと墜落していった。: Then it plummets to the ground.
ええ、<r=アマツミカボシ>天津甕星</r>は落ちたわ！\n戦闘終了、私達の勝利:
Yes, <r=アマツミカボシ>Amatsu-Mikaboshi</r> is down!
The battle's over! We've won!
って、舞亜、大丈夫！？\n今からそっちへ回収に行くから！:
Wait, Maia, are you all right?!
I'm coming to pick you up!
……ありがとう。\nみんなのおかげ。:
...Thank you.
I couldn't have done it without you.
今まで独りで戦うことの多かったヒイロ。仲間と共に勝利を得るという、\nこれまで知:
Until now, Hiiro has usually fought alone. A small smile forms on her lips
as she savors an unfamiliar joy: winning alongside her comrades.
